newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two die in grenade explosion on Colombian bus.
newsitem.headline: Two die in grenade explosion on Colombian bus.

text.p: Two people were killed and three were injured when a hand grenade exploded on a bus in the Caribbean coastal resort of Cartagena on Tuesday, Colombian television reported.
The blast ripped through the city bus when the man got on board to escape police after a failed attempt to extort money from a shopkeeper, the report said.
The man was one of those killed and two of the three injured were police in the street nearby, it added.
Authorities cordoned off the area and called in explosives experts to make safe another grenade found near the dead criminal's body.
Comment on the report from Cartagena police was not immediately available.
